name: Pedophiles
overview: Scripture sternly warns against causing harm or offense to innocent believers, especially children, emphasizing severe consequences for those who do so, as illustrated by the call for a millstone to be hung around the neck of anyone who leads a little one astray. Jesus acknowledges that offenses will occur but pronounces woe on those responsible for them. Furthermore, those who engage in abominable acts, including grievous sins against the vulnerable, face eternal judgment described as the second death in the lake of fire.
